_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-07 slate (Taipei 09-08). Eighth slate of the prospective test. Eleven games, all of them on the US card, all legible with first-half totals. This is the first slate since the reading rule was adopted where nothing conflicts: every one of the eleven favourites I read off the rows agrees with the US moneyline, and in each of the ten games showing the board's own moneyline column that column agrees too, extending a streak that has still never broken. The eleventh game, Diamondbacks at Royals, has no moneyline column, but the market puts Kansas City at 0.5119 with thirteen of fourteen books above even money and none below, which matches the row I read the handicap on. Minnesota at Detroit has no moneyline column either, but its double-result column prices Minnesota +1.5 at 0.550 against Detroit -1.5 at 1.600, so the board's own second market names Detroit -- also matching. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
